description: Controls the diagnostic logging output detail level for the Crusher Labs Observation Engine.

LOW_FIDELITY.label: Command/Strategic
LOW_FIDELITY.description: Stoplight indicators: GREEN (Clear), AMBER (Elevated Anomaly), RED (Critical Hazard). No numeric detail.

MID_FIDELITY.label: Certified Clinical
MID_FIDELITY.description: CAP-style certified lab reports: Patient/Zone ID, Assay Target, DETECTED/NOT DETECTED, formal Ct values, explicit QC validation flags.

HIGH_FIDELITY.label: Raw Synthetic Instrument
HIGH_FIDELITY.description: Raw machine telemetry: cycle-by-cycle amplification curves, raw background fluorescence, pre-normalization read counts, Dirichlet parameters, culture results, control line intensities.

quality_control.description: Cross-contamination: 0.01% mass carryover between consecutive samples. Negative controls run at frequency determined by intensity (low=1/12, medium=1/6, high=1/3).
